notes.cause: MEASURED: std::process::abort on Windows is a fast fail (exit 0xC0000409); Windows hands every fast fail to Windows Error Reporting, and `WerFault.exe -u -p <child>` holds the dying child until its report is done: 3.2-13.1 s alone, past 60 s under load. The process error mode does not stop it for a fast fail (child at 0x3 still held). SEM_NOGPFAULTERRORBOX does keep the overflow's unhandled exception out, but the children only had it by inheritance from the shell. The child's own work (start to abort call) took 30-34 ms. Not in src/diag_sink.rs; src untouched.
